statement: At the pinned Linux kernel revision, stock xpad lists Microsoft USB vendor 0x045e products 0x02d1 (Xbox One), 0x02dd (2015 firmware) and 0x02ea (Xbox One S) as XTYPE_XBOXONE without a Share mapping flag. It lists Xbox Series product 0x0b12 under the same XTYPE_XBOXONE with both Share and Share-offset flags; Elite and Adaptive identities have distinct mapping flags.

applicability.revision: standard first-party Xbox One and Xbox One S USB identities; Series and Elite comparison only
applicability.scope: xpad.c:127-134. A static USB consumer ID table, not proof of device firmware, hardware descriptors or successful binding.
